reasoning_content:
Login succeeded (HTTP 201) with admin@example.com/test. The app is fully functional. Let me do final verification and summarize.

Let me also check the test database preparation is not strictly needed for install. The devcontainer script prepares test db, but the guide focuses on dev. Let me also verify the background worker and make a final check.

Let me also make sure I note the app is listening on http://localhost:3000. Let me do a final verification snapshot.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Versions ==="
ruby --version; node --version; pnpm --version; foreman version; PGPASSWORD=zammad psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U zammad -d zammad_development -tc "select 'postgres OK'" 
redis-cli ping
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9200 | grep -o '"number" : "[^"]*"'
echo "=== App ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "Zammad HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/
echo "=== Processes ==="
ps aux | grep -E "puma|vite.js|websocket-server|background-worker|dartsass" | grep -v grep | wc -l
echo "processes running"
